claimModel.finalTokenMint: atomic with settlement; no placeholder or later reveal

setupModel.tokenRows: add_tokens_v35 declares sequential token ids, quantities, and commitments without expanding physical slots
setupModel.physicalSlots: append_token_slots_v35 fills canonical token-id order in resumable positive-count batches
setupModel.completion: finalize_setup requires slots_loaded == supply and next_slot_token_id == token_count
setupModel.fulfillmentHandshake: after local custody/readiness preflight, the configured finalizer must call arm_fulfillment before the administrator can activate_sale; pre-activation finalizer rotation resets the handshake
setupModel.fulfillmentArmedStorage: fulfillment_armed originates false, becomes true only through arm_fulfillment, and must be true for activate_sale

allocation.michelsonType: (pair bytes (pair chain_id (pair address (pair address (pair nat (pair address (pair address (pair nat (pair nat bytes)))))))))

measuredFundingPolicy.derivation: maximum observed V3.5 settlement storage/allocation burn + highest historical applied Macaroni V2 reveal baker fee
measuredFundingPolicy.finalizerStartup: finalizerStartupMutez covers five conservative settlement envelopes plus the measured arm_fulfillment cost; the finalizer must be revealed and retain at least that liquid balance
measuredFundingPolicy.settlementGate: every live estimated singleton settlement cost must fit inside minimumFulfillmentSubsidyMutez and the finalizer's fresh liquid balance

fulfillmentAccounting.activationReserve: paid-only stages require 5 * fulfillment_subsidy; any free stage requires max(5 * fulfillment_subsidy, physical_supply * fulfillment_subsidy)
fulfillmentAccounting.purchaseRetention: one immutable fulfillment_subsidy per paid unit
fulfillmentAccounting.reimbursement: one fulfillment_subsidy per successfully settled claim
fulfillmentAccounting.finalSweep: automatic after every created claim is settled and either all physical slots sold or the sale was irreversibly closed; close_sale may permanently cancel before activation and sweep immediately when no claims exist

trustDisclosure: Single-custodian precommitted hidden entropy is unpredictable to ordinary buyers who do not know its preimages, but the custodian knows future preimages, can simulate candidate outcomes when the other claim inputs are known, can selectively participate, and can withhold fulfillment. Two-step finalizer rotation preserves the entropy cursor and FIFO queue.
